effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_effect.des: Hoʻokomo i ka mea kaua make a me ka pale ʻana i ka pōʻino i ka manawa.Inā hoʻokau ʻia e ka Soul Sorcerer, e hāʻawi i ka pōʻino e pili ana i ka pākēneka e pili ana i ke olakino kiʻekiʻe o ka pahuhopu.
effect.ibarnorigins.casting_soul_firebal: Hoʻouka ʻana i ka Soul Fireball
ʻO ka mana ʻuhane ʻuhane o ka Soul Sorcerers.Hoʻā i kahi pōʻai ʻuhane ma ka hoʻonā hopena.
effect.ibarnorigins.soul_fire_strength_e: Hoʻonui i ka pōʻino melee e 50% ma ka pae 1 a me 100% ma ka pae 2.
effect.ibarnorigins.fire_weakness_effect: Hoʻonui i ka pōʻino mai nā kumu ahi e 100%.
effect.ibarnorigins.grant_soul_mage_attr: Hāʻawi i nā ʻano ʻuhane kilokilo
effect.ibarnorigins.revoke_soul_mage_att: Hoʻopau i nā ʻano o ka Soul Sorcerer
effect.ibarnorigins.grant_sand_person_at: Hāʻawi i nā ʻano o ke kanaka Sand
effect.ibarnorigins.revoke_sand_person_a: Hoʻopau i nā ʻano kanaka Sand
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soul_burn.play: Ua wela ka uhane o %1$s oiai e hoao ana e pakele %2$s
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast: %1$s ua vaporized e ka ikehu uhane
death.attack.ibarnorigins.soulBlast.play: %1$s ua hoʻohuehu ʻia e ka ikehu ʻuhane ʻoiai e hoʻāʻo ana e pakele %2$s
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.name: ʻO Ghaster
origin.ibarnorigins.ghaster.description: ʻO nā mamo mamao loa o nā Ghasts i hoʻopakele ʻia mai ka Nether a i lilo i kanaka ma muli o ko lākou ʻike lōʻihi ʻana i ka Overworld.
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.name: Kanaka Sand
origin.ibarnorigins.sandman.description: ʻO ka Kanaka Sand ka poʻe o ke one e noho ana i ke one.
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.name: Kahu ʻuhane
origin.ibarnorigins.soul_wizard.descript: He lāhui kanaka i hiki ke hoʻokahe i ko lākou ʻuhane.
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.name: Wraith maloo
origin.ibarnorigins.wither_phantom.descr: ʻO ka hapalua o ka hapalua ola ʻole i hoʻohui ʻia i hoʻopili mau ʻia me nā mana maloʻo ma muli o ka hui ʻana me nā core maloʻo.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.name: Nawaliwali Kino
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterexhaust.descri: ʻOiai ua maʻalahi ʻoe i ka Overworld, nāwaliwali kou kino, ʻoi aku ka lohi o kaʻu pōhaku, hana i ka 25% liʻiliʻi i ka pōʻino melee, a hiki ke hoʻopau koke.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.name: Hoʻomaka ʻana i ke kinipōpō ahi
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterfireball.descr: ʻOiai ua haʻalele ʻia ʻoe i ka Overworld, ua paʻa ʻoe i ke ʻano koʻikoʻi o ka puhi ahi o kou mau kūpuna, ma kahi liʻiliʻi.
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.name: Hoʻonui kālā
power.ibarnorigins.ghasterinflate.descri: ʻO ka lele ʻana i ka holo ʻana e hoʻoulu ʻoe a lana i luna no kahi manawa pōkole.
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.name: Ki Kū'ē
power.ibarnorigins.ki_immunity.descripti: Loaʻa iā ʻoe kahi kūʻē ikaika i ka pōʻino kilokilo.
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.name: Poepoe ahi uhane
power.ibarnorigins.kiblast.description: E hoʻopaʻa i kahi pōpō ahi e hoʻā ʻana i ka ʻuhane e hoʻonui i ka mana i ka piʻi ʻana o kou pae ʻike (ʻoi aku ma ka pae 100).
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_attributes.de: E hoʻemi i ka pōʻino i ka wā e kū ai ma luna o nā poloka one akā e hana wale i ka 50% o ka pōʻino inā ma kahi mea ʻē aʻe ma waho o ke one.Eia kekahi, e hānai mau ʻoe i kahi wao nahele.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.name: Hoʻohu Sand
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_sandbury.desc: Hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻeli iā ʻoe iho i ke one.ʻOiai ʻoe i ʻeli ʻia ʻaʻole ʻike ʻia ʻoe.
power.ibarnorigins.sandman_shovel_damage: E lawe i ka 150% hou aʻe i ka pōʻino mai nā pala.
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.name: Lauhulu Lapu
power.ibarnorigins.soul_speed.descriptio: ʻO ka ikaika o ka ʻuhane i ke one ʻuhane a me ka lepo ʻuhane e hiki ai iā ʻoe ke hele wikiwiki.
power.ibarnorigins.soulfire_strength.des: Hana i kahi 50% hou o ka pōʻino i ka wā e kū kokoke ana i nā kumu ahi ahi a i ʻole e paʻa ana i kā lākou mau mea.Eia kekahi, ʻo ke kū pololei i loko o ke ahi ʻuhane e hoʻonui i ka hoʻouka melee i 100% hou aʻe a me 50% hou aʻe i ka pōʻino pōpō ahi.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_fireweakness: ʻOiai ua maikaʻi ʻoe ma kahi kokoke i ke ahi ʻuhane, ʻo ke ahi e ʻā mau ana mai nā lama a me nā ahi hoʻomoana he hopena nāwaliwali loa iā ʻoe.No laila, lawe ʻoe i 100% hou aʻe i ka pōʻino mai ke ahi a hele makapō i ka lawe ʻana i nā pōʻino ahi.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_piglinfear.d: ʻO ka lapalapa o ka ʻuhane mua e ʻā ana i loko ou e hoʻoulu i ka makaʻu i loko o nā puaʻa wiwo ʻole a pau.
power.ibarnorigins.soulmage_vegetarian.d: ʻAʻole nui ka ikehu ʻuhane o ka ʻiʻo e like me nā mea kanu.No laila ʻaʻole mālama nui ka ʻiʻo akā hāʻawi nā mea kanu i ka ʻike ma ka ʻai ʻana ma muli o ke ʻano o ka hoʻopiha ʻana.
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.name: Homing Wither Skull
power.ibarnorigins.witherskull.descripti: E hoʻokaʻawale i nā pūʻali o ka undead a hoʻohui i nā iwi poʻo maloʻo e ʻimi nei i kou mau ʻenemi.
power.ibarnorigins.wp_item_prevention.de: ʻAʻole hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻaʻahu i nā mea kaua i ʻoi aku ka kiʻekiʻe ma mua o ka pale hao.
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.name: Hololele
power.ibarnorigins.wpairswim.description: He māmā loa kou kino a hiki iā ʻoe ke ʻau i ka lewa.
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.name: Nawaliwali
power.ibarnorigins.wphealth.description: Ma muli o kou hui ʻana, ua nāwaliwali loa kou kino (5 naʻau) a ʻaʻole hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻokaʻawale i nā pōʻino melee maka.
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.name: Nā Kuʻi Weʻe
power.ibarnorigins.wphit.description: Me kēlā me kēia pā e hoʻokau ʻoe i ka hopena maloʻo i kou ʻenemi.
